description: 기후에너지환경부 한강홍수통제소_예보소유역 FCSTMERGE 평균 강우량 [flood] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 기후에너지환경부 한강홍수통제소. 기후에너지 환경부 한강홍수통제소 FCSTMERGE 자료를 기반으로 계산된 예보소유역별로 평균강우량을 관리하는 데이터 항목이다. 예보소유역별 예보유역코드, 예보 소유역코드, 시간(년월일시분), 예측 평균강우량(10분 ~ 360분) 등 각 데이터 정보를 연계하여 사용자가 원하는 형태로 결과를 시각화하고 관리... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 기후에너지환경부 한강홍수통제소. Its tags are AI홍수예보플랫폼, AI홍수예측, 유역평균강우량, FCSTMERGE 자료 기반, 평균강우량 관리. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-11-21 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
